text: My head feels like it's goin' to explode any second now.
zh: 我这脑袋感觉随时都要炸开了。

text: Do you have sumthin' 'gainst this headache?
zh: 你有啥能治头疼的玩意儿吗？

text: Don't have any on me at the moment.
Uh, are you sure about that?
There's nothin' like a recovery beer after a long night drinkin'.
zh: 喝了一宿的酒，没啥比来瓶回魂酒更得劲的了。

text: I found Danny. He is dead.
I usually work the forge in the camp.
As long as I ain't hungover. Haha!
Balder's ain't fond of me drinkin', but that's his problem. *hic*
zh: 巴尔德不待见我喝酒，但那是他的事。*嗝*

text: Small fella', strange clothes, always drunk, maaagnificent mustache.
zh: 小个子，衣着古怪，成天醉醺醺，还留着一撮漂——亮的小胡子。

text: Oh, he must be who I found then. He's… dead, I'm afraid.
zh: 哦，那我找到的肯定就是他了。他……恐怕已经死了。

text: I have not met him yet.
Yesterday, that drunkard left to get more booze.
zh: 昨天，那个酒鬼出去找酒喝了。

text: He took my good hammer and went #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#south#text.default#.
zh: 他拿走了我那把好锤子，往#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#南边#text.default#去了。

text: Mentioned sumthin' about a booze hideout of a wizard.
zh: 嘟囔了句什么巫师藏酒的窝点。

text: Neither Danny, booze nor my hammer is here.
zh: 现在丹尼、酒、我的锤子，一样都没影儿。

text: If I weren't hungover, I'd be looking for him and beating his drunk ass.
zh: 要不是我还宿醉着，我早去找他，把他那醉醺醺的屁股揍开花了。

text: Could you look for him, lad?
Sure, I can look for Danny.
I don't have time for that, right now.

zh: 哎，别这样啊小子。那真可惜。

text: In case you find him, give him a beating he won't forget, haha!
zh: 要是碰到他，替我狠狠揍他一顿，让他一辈子忘不了，哈哈！

text: He was dead when I found him. There was nothing I could do.
zh: 我找到他时他已经死了。我无能为力。

text: In a cave, south of here.
I'll look for him later and give him a proper burial.
zh: 我回头去找他，好好把他安葬了。

text: No, I didn’t see any hammer.
zh: 没有，我没看见什么锤子。

text: Thanks lad. I really owe you one.
zh: 谢了小子。我真欠你一个人情。

text: I'll look for it later, I guess. *hic*
zh: 那我回头自己找找吧。*嗝*

text: It'd be better for me, to get my ass back into the camp.
zh: 我还是赶紧滚回营地比较好。

text: Balder's sure to be pissed already.
zh: 巴尔德八成已经气炸了。
不过先……*打开啤酒*……敬你，丹尼。

text: He left the camp before I came here.
zh: 我来这儿之前他就离开营地了。

text: Balder said that he is missin'.
I never liked that ol' sparkle finger.
zh: 我从来就不喜欢那个老火花指头。

text: Maybe he went north to the bandits.
zh: 说不定他往北投强盗去了。

text: Maybe he went south and fell into a hole of the goblins, haha!
zh: 说不定他往南走，掉进哥布林的洞里了，哈哈！

text: Be sure to meet me in the camp later, lad. I'll have something for you.
zh: 回头记得来营地找我，小子。我有东西给你。

text: You'll get compensated of course, haha!
zh: 当然少不了你的报酬，哈哈！
